meta.title: Image Cropper - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Crop images to the exact size you need. Fast, free, and private browser-based tool.
dragCornersToCrop: Drag corners or region to crop
jpegHighQualityWarning: High quality on compressed JPEG may increase file size.
steps_crop-image_1Desc: Select an image to crop. The full image loads in the cropping area where you can visually select the region to keep.
steps_crop-image_2Desc: Drag the crop handles to select your desired area. Choose a preset aspect ratio (1:1, 4:3, 16:9) or freely adjust. Preview updates in real time.
steps_crop-image_3Desc: Click Crop to apply the selection. The cropped image downloads immediately — your original remains intact for future edits.
